author: blu
body: A builtin the target cannot honestly perform is CDX2042, raised by emit-unknown-builtin: it is routed to emit-builtin and absent from x86-builtin-emitters, so the emitter refuses rather than quietly doing something else and reporting success. write-file used to print its content to the console and return 0, so a program that believed it had saved a file had saved nothing and was told it had -- worse than not having the builtin at all, because there is no error to notice.

author: blu
body: A citation can only be missing. A quotation can be missing, or a lie, or unsigned, or signed by a stranger, or forged, or simply not trusted enough -- and each of those is a different thing to tell someone, so each gets its own code. A compiler that answered all six with "could not resolve" would be telling the truth and saying nothing.
